items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: INTERVIEWER: When you were spending that year as a Gospel pianist...

ctx.x: That’s true. Yeah. I consider myself both. I was self taught when it came to guitar. I taught myself how to play guitar. But when I did go to school, to music school, I did learn the proper way to tune a guitar. I used to tune to an open G and I learned the proper way to tune a guitar when I went in to study music. And as a singer I went into my vocal major as a Gospel singer. I had grown up singing, so very much self taught in that way. But here I was learning how to not just read music, which I could read…
When you were spending that year as a Gospel pianist, did you — how did you figure out how to play Gospel piano?
I’m still figuring out how to play Gospel piano.
